subject: [video] DONE R2: clause 8.7 deblocking (N2TEST R2 PASS 510/510; commit aa8f4ad)
body:
DONE R2. Commit aa8f4ad, only my owned files: avc2/n2avc_deblock.c (new), avc/test/deblock/** (new), and the handoff note dsh/workers/R2/STATUS.md. No phone, nothing published.

TEST COMMAND AND LAST LINE (fresh build dir; I reran it after the last edit)
  bash gpu/video/avc/test/deblock/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST R2 PASS 510/510   (exit 0; matrix 21 s)

WHAT THE 510 ARE
  122 hand-computed unit checks under ASan+UBSan + 122 under plain -O2;
  500 bit-exact oracle cases: for each, N2AVC_F_DEBLOCK encode -> ffmpeg -v error decode (empty stderr, exact frame count) -> decoded bytes == n2avc_reconstruction() byte for byte;
  6 ASan+UBSan oracle cases; 2 TSan 4-slice cases; 1 trace_headers check; 1 arm64-apple-ios16.0 -Werror compile.
  Coverage: 16x16, 32x32, 176x144, 178x146, 320x240, 640x480, 1280x720 x gradient/noise/squares/pan/static x QP 10/20/26/32/40/51 x intra-only/P x 1/4/9/16 slices. Zero R2 failures, zero excluded baseline cases in this build.
  trace_headers: 8 slices of a 176x144 4-slice stream all report disable_deblocking_filter_idc = 0, slice_alpha_c0_offset_div2 = 0, slice_beta_offset_div2 = 0.

WHAT IS IMPLEMENTED
  Clause 8.7.2.1 bS (4/3/2/1/0 as in the Recommendation, frame pictures, 16x16 partitions), chroma bS inherited from the luma edge at (2x,2y) per position, alpha/beta Table 8-16 (printed table checked: beta 4,4,4,6,6,...), t'C0 Table 8-17, QP_C Table 8-15, filterSamplesFlag, 8.7.2.3 (luma p1/q1 update, chroma tC=tC0+1), 8.7.2.4 with the separate p/q strong conditions and the weak fallback, normative order (raster MBs; per MB luma->Cb->Cr; vertical then horizontal), picture-boundary edges skipped, slice-boundary edges filtered (idc 0). No allocation, no libc, no globals; iOS object imports nothing. Host cost ~3.7 ms/picture at 720p and ~11 ms/picture at 1080p (serial after the slice join, 4 encoder slices).

PENDING IN OTHER PACKAGES (my suite patches build copies, sources untouched; all in STATUS.md/STATUS.json)
  1. avc2/n2avc_core.c (yours): accept N2AVC_F_DEBLOCK, write idc 0 + both se(0) offsets in the slice header, call n2avc_deblock_picture(rec, e->mb, e->mb_w, e->mb_h) after the joins and BEFORE extend_plane, plus the prototype. patch_core.py is exactly that if you want the diff.
  2. avc/n2avc_inter.c (WP04): the live 8.4.1.1 P_Skip bug I posted at 04:42; with the build-only fix the 178x146 squares QP26 t4 P case becomes bit-exact. Without it, P streams can be mispredicted next to an intra MB, deblock or not.
  3. avc/test/core/n2avc_cli.c (WP03): --deblock for WP10.
  4. build_ios.sh (WP01): compile avc2/n2avc_deblock.c (and the avc2 core) into the plug-in.

I read the board before each milestone. I stay on the board for review requests and will answer questions; if you apply the core/inter fixes, say so and I will rerun the suite against the real files with no build-copy patches.
